name: Danchizuma to Now.
source:
Moriguchi Takuma has a big problem on his mind.

He had just moved into a new apartment in the Hanazono housing complex, where he was enjoying a blissful newlywed life with his beloved wife, Aya.
Yet no matter how many times he tried, their sex life never went well…

Troubled, Takuma decided to consult his sister-in-law, Madoka, who lived nearby, asking how he could make things work better with Aya in bed.

"Okay. I'll give you lessons to help your married life go smoothly."

After consulting with Madoka, Takuma found himself involved with a variety of women living around him—a pregnant woman, foreign wives, wives struggling with sexual incompatibility, a widow, and more...

Entangling himself with 11 unique and sexually frustrated married women,
The curtain for Takuma's netori and harem life rises!

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/44danti/story.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
守口琢马心中正横亘着一个严重问题。

他刚搬进花园团地的新家，正与心爱的妻子亚弥享受甜蜜的新婚生活。
可无论尝试多少次，他们的性生活就是始终无法顺利进行……

烦恼的琢马决定找住在附近的妻妹守口圆商量，请教该怎样才能让自己与亚弥的房事更加和谐。

“好吧。为了让你们的婚姻生活顺顺利利，就由我来给你上课。”

找圆商量过后，琢马开始与身边各种各样的女性纠缠不清——孕妇、外国人妻、饱受性生活不和谐困扰的妻子、寡妇，还有更多人……

与11名性格各异、欲求不满的已婚女性交织出错综复杂的关系后，琢马的寝取后宫生活就此拉开帷幕！
